description: A plain, hook-first copy voice for anything that sells — reports for business owners, mailers, website copy, subject lines and cold outreach. Short sentences, one-or-two-syllable words, no passive voice, the actual count instead of "several", and a dollar figure only where the math is honest. Use before writing any customer-facing copy, or when copy reads like AI-generated sales material.
